demos.title: Signals Basics
demos.teaches: Create reactive state with signal(). Use computed() for derived state and effect() for side effects. Read values by calling the signal as a function, update with .set() and .update().

demos.title: HTTP Resource API
demos.teaches: Load and display async data with httpResource(). Handle loading state, errors, and display data conditionally in templates.

demos.title: Signal Effects & Filtering
demos.teaches: Use effect() to react to signal changes for side effects. Track filter state with signals and update httpResource() parameters dynamically. Demonstrates conditional data loading.

demos.title: Input Signals
demos.teaches: Define typed component inputs as signals using input() and input.required(). Derive state from inputs with computed().

demos.title: Signal Equality
demos.teaches: Define custom equality comparisons with the equal option. Control when computed() and dependents re-run. Avoid unnecessary notifications for deep mutations.

demos.title: LinkedSignal & Reset
demos.teaches: Create writable dependent signals with linkedSignal(). Keep signals synced while allowing independent updates. Reset derived signals to base state.

demos.title: LinkedSignal with a Custom Set
demos.teaches: Intercept writes to a linkedSignal with the set option. Keep derived state writable while clamping or logging every write, and recompute it from its source.

demos.title: Effect Cleanup & One-Shot Effects
demos.teaches: Release timers and listeners with the onCleanup callback of effect(). Run initialization logic exactly once and stop an effect with its EffectRef destroy().

demos.title: Model Two-Way Binding
demos.teaches: Implement two-way binding with the model() signal API. Parent and child components sync data mutually without manual event handling.

demos.title: Signals Container-Presenter
demos.teaches: Apply the Container-Presenter pattern using signals. The container manages state and httpResource data, presenters display UI and emit events.

demos.title: RxJS Interop
demos.teaches: Bridge RxJS and signals with toSignal(), toObservable() and rxResource(). Consume streams as signals and drive streams from signal state.

demos.title: Chained Resources
demos.teaches: Sequence dependent async work with the chain() operator from the resource params context. Propagate loading, idle and error status down a chain of resources without manual undefined checks.

demos.title: Debounced Search
demos.teaches: Wrap a signal with debounced() from @angular/core and drive an httpResource search from the settled value. Read the debounce status to show a typing indicator.

demos.title: Service Decorator & injectAsync
demos.teaches: Declare services with the @Service() decorator and load them lazily with injectAsync() plus onIdle prefetching. Run the ng generate @angular/core:service-migration schematic to convert @Injectable.

demos.title: Reading the Signal Graph
demos.teaches: Build a deliberately layered dependency graph of signal, computed, linkedSignal, httpResource and effect nodes, name every node with debugName and read the graph in Angular DevTools.

markdownItems.title: Signal read vs write
markdownItems.comment: Calling the signal reads it, .set() replaces the value and .update() derives the next value from the current one.

markdownItems.title: httpResource status
markdownItems.comment: httpResource() exposes value(), isLoading() and error() as signals, so no manual subscribe or async pipe is needed.

markdownItems.title: When to reach for linkedSignal
markdownItems.comment: Use linkedSignal() when derived state must stay writable and reset itself once its source changes.

markdownItems.title: Always release timers
markdownItems.comment: The onCleanup callback of effect() runs before every re-run and on destroy, which is where intervals and listeners belong.

comments.title: Using @ngrx/store
comments.comment: To use @ngrx/store, we need to install it first.

comments.title: Optimizing change detection
comments.comment: In order to optimize change detection, we need to use OnPush strategy.
